title: Grid Grind
description:
Grid Grind is a retro-futuristic cyberpunk aesthetic themed arcade extraction game.  Acquire data fragments by grazing past hazards and circling them to clear them out, or extract them by collecting gold cubes and bringing them to the extraction point.  

• Risk reward gameplay: Earn even more fragments by extracting gold cubes; more gold cubes == more speed!

• Proximity scoring: Earn fragments by grazing past hazards and circling them

• Retro aesthetic: A low-fi, retro-digital look

• Multiple Challenges: Rush, Containment and Boss challenges keeps the intensity elevated at all times

• Game Modes: Game features a Boss Attack mode, as well as 2 unlockable modes.  Turn Left Mode restricts the player to only turning left, and 3P Mode changes the perspective entirely on how you play the game!

• Upgrade system: Unlocks permanent upgrades to push scoring, and stack program hacks during gameplay for extra boosts!

• Audio: Features music from composer Yaroslav Ozhogin / SoftLightStudio / OISS

Gameplay FeaturesGrazing/Circling hazards to score fragments and clear them out

Extract gold cubes at the extraction point to earn even more fragments

Unlock Program Hacks and Permanent Upgrades
description_short: Grid Grind is a retro-futuristic cyberpunk aesthetic themed arcade extraction game. Earn massive points by hording gold cubes and extracting them!! The more gold cubes == more speed!! A thrilling high risk reward gameplay setup where precision and timing is the key to maximizing your score.
